answers.moment: We got talking about Lisbon and the tiles on the outside of the houses, and the old bookshops. Then somehow we ended up linking the tile colours to the blue-green glazes on my bowls, which I'd honestly never thought about. And we came back round to my tutor calling my glazes brave and had a bit of a laugh about it. It was the point where I stopped being so guarded and it felt more like a proper conversation.
answers.reason: It made me think about pottery differently.
